newsitem.title: USA: Apache well tests 22 mln cubic ft gas a day.
newsitem.headline: Apache well tests 22 mln cubic ft gas a day.

text.p: Apache Corp said it has completed a well that flowed 22 million cubic feet (MMcf) of natural gas per day, but due to current limitations on plant capacity, the well is expected to be produced at a rate of eight MMcf of gas per day.

Apache said that it the horizontal gas well Harmattan 12-16-33- 3 in Alberta, Canada, flowed 22 million cubic feet (MMcf) of gas per day on an open-hole test during drilling operations. The company owns a 100 percent working interest in the new producer.

It said that due to current limitations on plant capacity, it expects the well to be produced at a rate of eight million cubic feet of gas per day when connected to pipeline, which is anticipated to occur in June.
In addition to the gas, the Apache-operated well also flowed 150 barrels per day of condensate.

Apache said that due to efficient drainage expected from the Harmattan 12-16-33-3, it plans to recomplete its nearby Harmattan 6-16 well, which currently produces from the Elkton formation, in an uphole zone.
The company also plans to participate in three additional Elkton wells in the unitized portion of the Harmattan field area before year end.
The well is located in west-central Alberta, south of Shell Canada Ltd's Caroline natural gas field.
